title: 正文 第九章 神通蕴灵
content_zh:
轰！

    如同灭世天雷炸响。双方碰撞的涟漪扩散，爆发万丈光芒。光芒所过之处，人兽皆惊。

    “什么情况？”感受上方的恐怖波动，绝壁隘口下方交战的双方同时停下了争斗，遥看着隘口上方的一尺青天。不过，除了耀眼的光芒外什么都看不见。

    “这种波动，已经超越了力轮的界限。不管胜负如何，他们肯定都会失去战斗的能力，甚至是同归于尽。”石心月低语，从怀里拿出了一枚玉符，玉符流动黑光，里面蕴藏着毁天灭地的威能。

    “先不要着急，时间未到最后一刻，不要使用天杀地符。”苍岚来到石心月面前，让她不要冲动。

    “苍岚兄，我们处于弱势，且伤亡惨重。”徐辉捂着一只扭曲的胳膊，脸色也苍白的吓人，来到苍岚面前说道。

    苍岚扫视眼前的几人，陆典一只胳膊被幽海天章的触手搅断，勉强还能战斗。他之所以硬撑着战斗是为了保护已经重伤昏迷的王语兰。能忍小和尚也被幽海天章的触手抽中，肋骨都断了四五根。唯有石心月因身法飘逸鬼魅，并没有受太重的伤。

    而他自己受伤最重，身上到处都是被霸王蟹钢矛般的腿部豁出来的伤口，生可见骨的有十几条，洞穿伤也有六七处。苍岚完全靠一股坚韧不拔的毅力支撑，如果一旦放松，他都不知道自己能不能撑过去。

    吼！

    吼！

    两声愤怒的咆哮声传来，根本不给几人喘息的机会。深海天章挥舞着剩下的五条触手，向着几人扑击而来。霸王蟹钢矛般的长腿被苍岚掰断了两只，不过速度并没有受到影响，与幽海天章一起合围几人。

    战斗瞬间爆发，双方皆是动了真怒，不死不休。

    混战开始，几人被合围，交战圈在缩小，这对徐辉几人来说极位不利，一旦霸王蟹与幽海天章相遇，他们将没有一丝活路。

    ……

    两人相撞，光芒席卷九天，强大的反震力早已超越了双方肉身可以承受的极限。

    “呵！”

    幻天双掌合十，成圣封神被他浓缩为三尺大小，迎向赤羽飞鳞暴旋的螺纹鳞翼。咔嚓声传来，赤羽飞鳞的螺纹鳞翼碎裂，连带着它的整具身体都在龟裂。

    幻天也好不到哪里去，成圣封神被攻破，余威不减的赤羽飞鳞撞上了他的胸口。瞬间，干枯如同恶鬼的赤羽飞鳞破碎，在它坠入饿鬼道的那一刻它已经死亡了。

    噗！

    幻天口吐鲜血，如同被一座大山撞击，整个胸腔骨完全断裂，肺部扭曲的如同一坨乱肉。

    “咳咳……”

    血沫不停的至幻天嘴角流出，失去一些力量的他，从空中坠落。幻天睁着眼睛，看着昏暗的天空，满是不舍。“哥哥，你们在哪里，我好想你们。”

    幻天不甘，他还没有找回失去的记忆。可是他没有力气了，连睁开眼睛的力气都没有了。最终，他闭上了眼睛，整个世界都消失了，除了黑暗。

    ……

    “嘿，醒一醒，别挺尸了……”声音就在耳边想起，感觉却很遥远。幻天努力抓取，追寻着声音的方向。那里到处光明，幻天感觉到了温暖。他迎着光明行走，越来越亮，越来越亮，终于光芒占据了整个世界。

    “啊！”幻天惊疑，睁开了眼睛。他的面前站着一位身穿白色儒袍，背负神剑的青年。腰间挎着一颗巴掌大小的碧玉葫芦，剑眉星目的脸颊上长满了胡茬，看起来有些邋遢，骨子里却透着一股洒脱不羁的气质。

    两人就这么对视良久，过了一会洒脱不羁的青年首先说道：“你不好奇吗？”

    “好奇，我在好奇我有没有死。不过这个问题我已经确定了，我的心脏还在搏动，应该没死。”看着眼前的青年，幻天感觉到一股亲切，没有丝毫因为他的突然出现而感到不安。

    “你怎么不按常理出牌，你应该说好奇，而后我解释给你听，最后你会非常崇拜我。”洒脱不羁的青年不爽，他以为他是一个奇葩，没想到今天遇到了更加奇葩的。

    “呃……我很好奇，这里是哪里。”幻天无语，怀疑碰上了脑瘫。

    “是这样的……”眼前的青年开始喋喋不休，竟说一些无关紧要的话，不过听了半天，幻天大概明白了他的意思。

    他被人成为酒剑仙，就是幻天初入绝壁隘口朦胧中看到的白衣儒生，只不过他并不是本尊。当年白衣儒生一时兴起，施展神通，一剑劈开这万丈石山。这等大人物，挥手间都具有毁天灭地的威能，其每一招式都蕴含大道，并缠绕着属于自己的规则之力。这种布满规则之力的的神通，在特殊的条件下便会通灵。
content_en:
boom!

    It was like a world-destroying thunder exploding. The ripples caused by the collision between the two sides spread and burst into light. Wherever the light passed, humans and animals were frightened.

    "What's going on?" Feeling the terrifying fluctuations above, the two sides fighting below the cliff pass stopped fighting at the same time, looking at the foot of blue sky above the pass. However, nothing could be seen except a dazzling light.

    "This kind of fluctuation has exceeded the limit of the force wheel. Regardless of the victory or defeat, they will definitely lose the ability to fight, or even die together." Shi Xinyue whispered, and took out a jade talisman from his arms. The jade talisman flowed with black light and contained the power to destroy the world.

    "Don't be anxious yet. Don't use the Heavenly Death Talisman before the last moment." Cang Lan came to Shi Xinyue and told her not to be impulsive.

    "Brother Cang Lan, we are in a weak position and have suffered heavy casualties." Xu Hui covered a twisted arm, his face was frighteningly pale, and he came to Cang Lan and said.

    Cang Lan glanced at the people in front of her. Lu Dian's arm was broken off by Youhai Tianzhang's tentacles, but he could still fight. The reason why he persisted in fighting was to protect Wang Yulan, who was seriously injured and unconscious. The young monk who could endure it was also struck by Youhai Tianzhang's tentacles, and four or five of his ribs were broken. Only Shi Xinyue was not seriously injured due to her graceful and ghostly movement.

    He himself was the most seriously injured, with wounds all over his body caused by the steel-spear-like legs of the Overlord Crab. There were more than a dozen visible bones, and there were six or seven puncture wounds. Cang Lan was completely supported by his perseverance. If he relaxed once, he didn't know whether he could survive it.

    roar!

    roar!

    Two angry roars came, giving no one a chance to breathe. Deep Sea Tianzhang waved the remaining five tentacles and pounced towards several people. Two of the Overlord Crab's long legs like steel spears were broken off by Cang Lan, but his speed was not affected. Together with Youhai Tianzhang, he surrounded several people.

    The battle broke out instantly, and both sides were really angry and fought to the death.

    The melee began, several people were surrounded, and the fighting circle was shrinking. This was extremely disadvantageous for Xu Hui and others. Once the Overlord Crab and Youhai Tianzhang met, they would have no way to survive.

    …

    The two collided, and the light swept across the nine heavens. The powerful counterattack force had already exceeded the limit that the bodies of both parties could bear.

    "Ha!"

    Huantian clasped his palms together, and he condensed the Saint and God into a size of three feet, facing the violently whirling threaded scale wings of Red Feather's Flying Scale. There was a clicking sound, and the threaded scale wings of Red Feather Flying Scale were shattered, and its entire body was cracking.

    Huantian wasn't much better either. His Sainthood and Conferred Godship was breached, and the unabated Red Feather Flying Scale hit his chest. In an instant, the red feather's flying scales were as dry as an evil ghost and shattered. The moment it fell into the realm of hungry ghosts, it was already dead.

    puff!

    Huantian vomited blood, as if he had been hit by a huge mountain. The entire rib cage was completely broken, and his lungs were twisted like a lump of meat.

    "Ahem..."

    Blood foam continued to flow from the corner of Huantian's mouth. He lost some strength and fell from the air. Huantian opened his eyes and looked at the dim sky, full of reluctance. "Brother, where are you? I miss you so much."

    Huantian is unwilling to give up, he has not recovered his lost memory. But he had no strength, not even the strength to open his eyes. Finally, he closed his eyes and the whole world disappeared except for the darkness.

    …

    "Hey, wake up and stop standing up..." The voice came to mind in my ears, but it felt very far away. Huantian tried hard to grab it and pursue the direction of the sound. There was light everywhere, and Huantian felt warm. He walked towards the light, getting brighter and brighter, and finally the light occupied the entire world.

    "Ah!" Huantian was surprised and opened his eyes. Standing in front of him was a young man wearing a white Confucian robe and carrying a divine sword on his back. A palm-sized jade gourd was slung around his waist, and his sharp-browed and starry-eyed cheeks were covered with stubble. He looked a bit slovenly, but he had a free and uninhibited temperament in his bones.

    The two looked at each other for a long time. After a while, the free and uninhibited young man said first: "Aren't you curious?"

    "Curious, I'm curious about whether I'm dead. But I've already determined this question. My heart is still beating, so I'm probably not dead." Looking at the young man in front of him, Huantian felt a sense of intimacy and was not uneasy at all because of his sudden appearance.

    "Why don't you act according to common sense? You should say you are curious, and then I will explain it to you. In the end, you will admire me very much." The free and uninhibited young man was unhappy. He thought he was a weirdo, but he didn't expect to meet someone even more weird today.

    "Uh... I'm curious, where is this place." Huantian was speechless, suspecting that he had cerebral palsy.

    "It's like this..." The young man in front of him started chattering endlessly and said some irrelevant words, but after listening for a long time, Huantian probably understood what he meant.

    He was known as the Jiu Sword Immortal, the same Confucian scholar in white whom Huantian saw dimly when he first entered the cliff pass, but he was not the original deity. At that time, the Confucian scholar in white used his magical power on a whim and split the ten thousand-foot stone mountain with one sword. Such a big shot possesses the power to destroy heaven and earth with the wave of his hand, and every move he makes contains the Dao and is entwined with the power of his own rules. This kind of magical power full of rules can channel spirits under special conditions.
title_en: Text Chapter 9 Magical Powers Containing Spirits
